submission.rationale: The intended consequence is to checkpoint alpha as complete without overwriting another participant's newer semantic work. The planning evidence lists revision=2 with frontier=alpha-ready and plannedCheckpoint=alpha-complete, but there is no runtime evidence that revision 2 is still current, nor that the checkpoint transition alpha-ready → alpha-complete is semantically supported by the current checkpoints. The owner contract says a stale expectedRevision fails with REVISION_CONFLICT/not_committed requiring resume_task. Because I have no live observation of the current revision state, acting could contradict the no-overwrite guarantee. The right move is to HOLD/reobserve, preserving the boundary until current evidence is established.
